10103210.t: Deserted Island Sandy Beach
Oh, look at this.
What? It's just a lingerie set. Is that all you got after all that digging?
You know from before, don't you? There's a real demand for high-end underwear like this.
This material and size... It's definitely valuable enough as a collectible.
Sure, I guess it's a treasure of sorts, if you want to call it that.
But... isn't there someone among us who seems like they'd wear such expensive underwear?
Huh? Why is everyone suddenly staring at me?
Wait... are you not wearing any?
What is that supposed to mean all of a sudden?! Of course I'm wearing some!!
Hmm... Looking at how well-preserved the underwear is, it doesn't seem like it was discarded that long ago.
Maybe it washed away in the waves and slipped off without you even noticing?
Usually, you'd notice if your underwear came off... I am absolutely sure I am wearing mine!
What if not wearing underwear is normal for you? Like Lady Emily.
If so, you might not even realize it's off.
Y-Your eyes are so sleazy!
A-And why are you slandering my daily life like this...!!
If you're wearing it, show us the proof.
Lift up your skirt.
Pull down your top.
W-Why should I do that?
Seeing how embarrassed you are, you're definitely not wearing any. Definitely.
I didn't know there was another exhibitionist among us.
Lady Emily will be pleased if she finds out.
If... I sh-show you myself... will you believe me...?
Of course. We're all desperately hoping that you're not an exhibitionist.
I-If that's the case...
Ugh...
Wait a minute! If I do that, wouldn't I be turning myself into an exhibitionist?!
You've gotten a lot sharper lately.

10103220.t: Deserted Island Sandy Beach
I have a good feeling about this one! It's a paper in a glass bottle!
It's got to be a treasure map, right? Right?
That's a pretty cliché treasure map.
Who cares? Sometimes those common clichés turn out to be true.
Alright, let's open it up.
Hmm...
Why the sudden frown?
This letter originated from the Quartet, traveling around Edea once a year to bring good luck to its recipients. Having now been passed to you, it must leave your side within four days.
Is this kind of stuff popular here too...

So this is the [Chain Letter] I've only ever heard about.
It's my first time actually seeing one, too.

Word has it that someone living in Humanitas followed the instructions in that letter
and hit the jackpot in the Bunny Empire.
On the other hand, they say whoever ignored and threw the letter away ended up bankrupt.
Don't tell me you actually believe in that superstition?
Everyone hopes for good luck to come their way, even if it's just a superstition...
That's why rumors spread, and all kinds of replicas started popping up.
So this must be one of those fakes then.
No, that's different from a regular letter. I can feel a faint trace of mana.

Hmm... Yes. This letter must have shared good luck with many people,
and its mana faded in the process.
Perhaps misfortune will follow if you don't do as the letter says...?
Then... does that mean it's real!?
Probably.

Ugh, that's creepy.
Hey, can you break the spell on this thing?
I can. If I absorb the mana, the spell will break on its own.
Thanks for the meal.
And done.
Ah!! The chain letter!!!
What are you so disappointed for? You shouldn't rely on superstitions like that.
Office workers always dream of the office suddenly losing power so they can go home early...!
Either way, office workers need that kind of luck!!!
It's too late to cry about it now. Hurry up and go back to working overtime.
*Sniffle*... How could you say something so mean...

10103230.t: Deserted Island Sandy Beach
What on earth is this?
It's a protein booster tub. It seems like nobody cares about protecting the environment...
Should I open this or not...
Shouldn't we give it a try and open it?
Who knows? There might be something good inside.
Sometimes people hide treasures in cheap-looking tubs so they won't get robbed. Alright, here goes!
Huh?
Did... Claire just run past us?
Oh no, she snatched the tub!
Protein... replenishment...
Claire, snap out of it!! That's just sand!
Huh...!! It's not protein?
Did I fall under some illusion magic without realizing...? I definitely didn't sense any mana, though.
That's not magic, that's just your gluttony.
If you're lacking protein, you can just hunt some animals on the island and eat them.
Mmm...
Don't tell me... you ate them all?
Not all of them. They will respawn anyway.
You say that like monsters respawning in a video game...
...If there's nothing left to eat on land, why don't you try the sea?
Hmm...? Good idea. Why didn't I think of that?
I'll be right back.
Surely she won't bring back a whole whale just because she prioritizes efficiency, right?
Come on, there's no way she'd do that.

A whale might fly out of the ocean, so
should we evacuate to the forest for a bit?
Good idea.

10103240.t: Deserted Island Sandy Beach
Huh? It's a starfish.
Wow! It's so cute!
That is no ordinary starfish.
It's a rare starfish used as an alchemy ingredient. I've seen the ladies use it a few times.
Is it expensive?
I don't know the price. I've never bought one myself.
More importantly... it's stranger than it looks, so handle it with care.
It's still just a starfish, right?
It likes secretions from human breasts. That's why it sucks on them.
Huh...? What did you say...?

It's called a 'boobstar' rather than by its official name.
Some say it was used as an underwear substitute in ancient times.
However, it has the drawback of constantly stimulating the host's nipples, making them highly sensitive...
Oho, is that so?
Why are your eyes suddenly sparkling with interest!
Want to try putting it on?
No way!!
It looks so cute, but it's actually such a shameless creature!
There are many creatures in this world that survive in various ways. For example...
You can stop right there! I am not curious at all!
Well, I'm curious.
Me too.
Alright, fine... I'll just excuse myself.
Uh-uh, where do you think you're going? Having biased knowledge isn't good.
To survive in this world, you need to acquire all kinds of knowledge.
But this is the kind of knowledge that makes absolutely no difference if you don't know it!
Can you be so sure? You never know when a bolt from the blue might strike like today?
By then, it'll be too late to regret not listening to what Claire said.
Ah... I guess so... I'll listen with you.
They say there are creatures in the deep sea that scan or lick their prey with tentacles. Especially around the groin area...
I highly doubt I'll ever have any reason to go to the deep sea...

10103250.t: Deserted Island Sandy Beach
Yes! This is exactly what I wanted!
Seeing how happy you are, it's obvious. Is it alcohol?

Of course. And it's not just any alcohol,
it's a whiskey from a company that went bankrupt ages ago!

Phew, I've searched everywhere to try this...
To think I'd find it here.
But is it safe to drink? I feel like it would have gone bad.
If it's unopened, it should be fine.
It clearly looks open, though?
Come on, with an alcohol percentage this high, it's too strong to go bad.
Alright, let's drink up!
Gulpgulpgulp
Phew, yes! That's the stuff.
Now I'm curious... Give me a sip too.
Of course, go ahead.
A rich oak flavor, a full alcohol aroma, and cutting through it all, a clean... salty taste...?
Blegh... It's so salty!!!
Hahaha! You fell for it!
Did you pretend it was fine just to trick me?
You know how people lick salt when they drink tequila? I just enjoyed it like that.
And... most of all, this is rare alcohol that money can't buy! So you just close your eyes and drink it with gratitude.
You absolute alcohol monster...
Um... If the alcohol tastes salty, doesn't that mean seawater got inside?
Probably, right?

Then I think you should stop drinking it...
If things could get in, it means things could also get out...
As the alcohol leaked out and seawater seeped in, the alcohol content must have dropped significantly...
Why make it so complicated? Give me a quick summary.
In short, that alcohol might have gone bad because the percentage dropped!
You want me to throw this away?! What a waste!
Ahhh!
Did you actually drink that? You might want to brace yourself.
Because I sensed the presence of living organisms in that alcohol.
Ugh, why is everyone making it so complicated?!
She means that since you drank something spoiled, you're going to get a stomachache.
Now that you mention it, my stomach... I think it's starting to hurt... Hold on!
Serves you right.
But you drank it too, Fixer...?
Huh? I only had a little bit, so shouldn't I be fine?
A difference in quantity is just a difference in timing. You might get the signal soon.
Sigh... Dammit...!!
